metadata.question: Did Bellingham, Washington experience at least 30cm of rainfall between September and November 2021?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in Bellingham, Washington between September and November 2021, specifically if there was at least 30cm (300mm) of rainfall. For precipitation data, I should use: - CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) - good for rainfall analysis - Or GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) data Let me use CHIRPS daily precipitation data which provides rainfall in mm. Steps: 1. Define geometry for Bellingham, Washington (I'll use a point with buffer) 2. Filter CHIRPS collection for Sep-Nov 2021 3. Check if collection has data 4. Sum the precipitation over the period 5. Convert to cm and check if >= 30cm 6. Handle potential data issues For validation: - Check collection size - Check valid pixel count after processing - Validate the result isn't null/NaN I'll use a scale of 5000m for reduceRegion to avoid timeout. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const bellingham = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.482, 48.751]).buffer(5000); // Buffer around Bellingham const startDate = '2021-09-01'; const endDate = '2021-11-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(bellingham); const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum precipitation over the period const totalPrecip = chirps.sum(); // 4. Calculate statistics const stats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: bellingham, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanPrecip = stats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); const pixelCount = stats.get('precipitation_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean Precipitation (mm): ${meanPrecip ? meanPrecip.toFixed(1) : 'None'}`); console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${pixelCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (meanPrecip === null || meanPrecip === undefined || isNaN(meanPrecip)) { console.log("C3"); } else { const precipCm = meanPrecip / 10; // Convert mm to cm console.log(`Total Precipitation (cm): ${precipCm.toFixed(1)}`); if (precipCm >= 30) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
